description: Source file implementing the Toolchain class for managing build tools and their types, including methods for retrieving and setting tools, and handling different source file types and target outputs.

classes.name: Toolchain
classes.description: Manages a collection of build tools, providing methods to retrieve tools by name and type, and to set up the toolchain.

methods.name: GetTool
methods.description: Retrieves a tool by name from the tool collection.

methods.name: SetTool
methods.description: Adds or replaces a tool in the tool collection.

methods.name: ToolchainSetupComplete
methods.description: Finalizes the setup of the toolchain, merging substitution bits from all tools.

methods.name: GetToolForSourceType
methods.description: Retrieves the tool suitable for a given source file type.

methods.name: GetToolForTargetFinalOutput
methods.description: Retrieves the tool for the final output of a target.
